name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – After § 18 – Am 12
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 18a.* *Calls on the Ukrainian authorities to outlaw the non-governmental organisation Myrotvorets, which cooperates with Ukraine’s Security Service (SBU) and its Ministry of Internal Affairs, and which has included on its list of ‘enemies of Ukraine’ Polish presidential candidate Sławomir Mentzen, following his visit to Lviv aimed at drawing attention to the fact that the disgraceful cult of Stepan Bandera and Roman Shukhevych – criminals responsible for the massacre of over 100 000 Poles during the Volhynia massacre – continues to persist in Ukraine;
